description: Provenance of the two typefaces the design module bundles (design sections 12.1, 13.1 and 17). Each file is a byte-identical copy of the file at source_path in the upstream repository at the pinned commit. Android resource names allow only lower-case letters, digits and underscores, so each font is renamed in res/font; its bytes are not changed. The licence and trademark files sit in assets, which the app ships, so that every copy of the fonts carries its licence (OFL condition 2); res/font holds font files only. design's FontSourceTest checks every digest below and that res/font holds no other file.

fonts.name: Google Sans Flex
fonts.provenance_note: The variable font with all six axes (GRAD, ROND, opsz, slnt, wdth, wght), shipped whole. OFL.txt names no Reserved Font Name; TRADEMARKS.md allows the Google Sans Flex name only in connection with the original font software, so the file is not instanced or subset, and a modified file would need another name.

fonts.name: Google Sans Code
fonts.provenance_note: The upright and the italic variable fonts (wght), shipped whole. OFL.txt names no Reserved Font Name; TRADEMARKS.md allows the Google Sans Code name only in connection with the original font software.
